data.long_meaning: Mehravah is derived from the Persian word 'mehr' which means sun or light. The name signifies a person who radiates positivity and illuminates the lives of those around them. The name Mehravah carries the meaning “Sun, light, radiant” and is chosen by families in Islamic traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Arabic tradition and is also used in Arabic, Urdu, Persian. Parents who choose Mehravah usually hope their child will grow to embody sun, light, radiant and live with faith, good character and purpose.
